title: Victoria’s Secret
full_description: Welcome to the Victoria's Secret App: your go-to destination for discovering new trends, exclusive offers, and the latest and greatest content like Verifyt, Netvirta's new 3D-scanning technology, which helps you find the best bra in just a few clicks. And did we mention? It's the easiest place for Cardmembers to manage their account. Simply save your payment method for a streamlined shopping experience, instantly manage your bills, and so much more.
